title: John Paul DeJoria’s Texas ranch sold for $6.93 million; 120 exotic animals included
summary_full: In a remarkable real estate deal, the sprawling Texas ranch of Patrón Tequila co-founder John Paul DeJoria has been acquired for $6.93 million. Spanning 96 acres, this unique property was home to over 120 exotic African animals, including gazelles and wildebeest. Complete with a luxurious main residence and an underground shelter, the estate also boasted a well-stocked pond.
